verdict.rationale: xAI documents its own US regional endpoint (us.api.x.ai) for customers who need request handling and model inference to happen in the United States, which is a first-party residency control. However, it covers processing location rather than where data is stored, and only one region is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit control over data storage location (files, collections, retained logs), regions beyond the US, documentation of what data stays in-region, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: If you need API request handling and model inference to happen in the United States, use the US regional endpoint, `https://us.api.x.ai/v1`.
